title: AiAtTheServer
description: Add AI to your minecraft server without api key! Download and use!
body:
# AiAtTheServer:
**This is Plugin That add a Ai to your MineCraft Server.**
This plugin use a api from Pollination.ai for Working.

**Plugin is long time in "Archive" Mode but now i want to make this plugin and i think soon i will be make 1st update**

## ⁉️Versions and Faq:

**Currenct Plugin Version**: 1.0

**Enable Minecraft Version**: 1.21 - 1.21.11

**Spigot Only**

**Will there be updates?**: Yes because at the plugin is much bug's that i want ficks in the future.

**Does this plugin have any dependencies?**:
No, the only thing you need is the Internet, but I'm sure that if players can access your Minecraft server via IP or something like that, then you have Internet access.

## ⌨️Commands:
/ai on - on the ai for the player.

/ai off - off the ai for the player .

/aia disable - off the ai for Full Server.

/aia allow - allow the ai for Full Server.

## 📝Config:

```
# Available languages: en "English", ua "Ukrainian", de "Germany".
language: en

# If true, AI turns on automatically when there is only 1 player online.
# If a second player joins, AI turns off.
auto-enable-single-player: true

# The "Instruction" for the AI. Tell it who it is.
ai-system-prompt: "You are a helpful AI assistant on a Minecraft server. Keep answers short and fun."
```
**Why is this plugin helpful❔:**
This plugin help player to know more about server, because they can speak with ai and he can explain server command and so on.

And
This plugin help with Boredom Wenn at the server is only 1 player and he want speak with another player's Then he can speak with ai.
